title: Render the routed principles in bee orient and the session preamble
action: Write ONE shared renderer that parses the '## Principle homes' section added by ep-1 and returns the rows whose `classes:` list contains the recorded route class. Call it from both surfaces, never duplicating the logic: the session preamble beside its Route line (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs:545) and bee orient's line block (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/status_full/orient.rs:623-660). Output is a short block naming each matching principle and its spoken line. Emit nothing at all when no route is recorded, when the class matches zero rows, or when the section is absent — an empty header is worse than silence. Add unit tests for: a class with matches, a class with zero matches, no route recorded, a row listing several classes, and the section missing.

truths: One renderer, two callers — the class filter is written once (CONTEXT.md D2).
The principle index is read on demand from the concept file, never inlined as a constant in Rust.
Absent route, zero matches, and a missing section each produce NO block, not an empty one.
The existing session_preamble tests still pass — the block is added beside the Route line, not in place of anything.
